fusions.name: Scorched Litter
fusions.desc: Lights 3 rats and lets them run, spread apart, each dealing 3 fire damage with a 40% chance to leave the target [Burning] for 4 seconds. The burning spreads on its own to up to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Tinder Nest
fusions.desc: Hurls a burning nest that deals 30 fire damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that. It leaves the target [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Burning Straw Behind
fusions.desc: Lays a line of burning straw 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. Anything that crosses it is set [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cinder Whiskers
fusions.desc: A smouldering rat runs with you as a familiar, biting enemies within 5 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds and leaving them [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
